subject: FacilityOperation operator cardinality
decision_for_2_1_candidate: Exactly one OperatingOrganizationRole and one OperatedFacilityRole per FacilityOperation; shared or successive operations use distinct relators with their own IDs and time/context
rationale: An operation assignment has one accountable organizational participant; independent relators preserve time and provenance and fit W6 single FK without ruling out joint activity across distinct assignments
evidence: ORSD FR-01/FR-03; W6 M011 schema; G3-P4a native/OWL/SHACL; issue #317 D03
negative_boundary: Never infer a global unique operator for a facility; never merge two organizations into one; OWL missing values stay unknown
review_in_later_release: Reconsider true jointly held single-operation evidence and time/tuple policy before GA or next minor release

subject: Derived operates
decision_for_2_1_candidate: Define operates by the chain inverse(operationOrganization) then operationFacility; do not assert it from co-location or label
rationale: The relation has a FacilityOperation truthmaker and can be reproduced without duplicating asserted source facts
evidence: FR-01/FR-03 bounded tests #316; G3-P4a material relation annotation; #317 D04
negative_boundary: No operation relator yields no derived triple; open-world absence is not falsity
review_in_later_release: Review source evidence and OWL DL profile/full validation before GA

subject: Four domain mini ontologies
decision_for_2_1_candidate: Retain RM/PV/BA/DS as purposeful separate experimental modules; do not promote provisional connectors and unsourced roles to stable 2.1 core
rationale: Honors accepted modular direction while 24 ORSD module rows and scientific interfaces remain in review
negative_boundary: Do not count prototype tests as author/expert acceptance
review_in_later_release: Review detailed semantics, imports and each module acceptance before GA

subject: W6 database projection
decision_for_2_1_candidate: Preserve 2.0 W6 schema/data and register versioned 2.1 migration contract; no automatic namespace rewrite
rationale: #317 identified 36 declared mappings, missing operation exporter and conditional cardinality delta
evidence: Inventory 0.1.0 #317; issue #307; #318 copied PostgreSQL/PostGIS M1 run 40224419469; 4/4 legacy pairs twice; Q21-01 7/7 tuples; before/after hashes equal

review_in_later_release: Execute #319–#321 with source-backed witnesses, semantics and copied DB parity; review all remaining 29 unimplemented and M023/M035/M036 dispositions

subject: ORSD document freeze
decision_for_2_1_candidate: Keep ORSD 0.2.0 and ledger 0.2.0 as versioned research specification; do not label ORSD 1.0.0 yet
rationale: 83 rows pending semantic/author review; three fresh bounded contracts are not full acceptance
negative_boundary: No automatic promotion of 69 Must candidates or full requirement acceptance

subject: Release channel

rationale: Makes an inspectable 2.1 artifact available without claiming finished ontology or empirical generalization
negative_boundary: No GA tag, merge to stable main or article claim based only on a prerelease
